estimates.t: There have been no changes to our critical accounting policies during the nine months ended September 30, 2026 .

statements.t: “In addition, leverage continued to improve and is expected to further improve towards year-end on the back of our usual seasonal strong fourth quarter cash flow.”
"Given the market headwinds and supply chain disruptions, we are updating our guidance for full year 2026."

dropped.t: “We expect continued strong revenue conversion in the back half of the year, with revenue increasing sequentially through the rest of the year.”
“Our continued focus on working capital efficiency and disciplined capital allocation is translating into stronger cash generation and ongoing deleveraging going forward,” said Marco Portmann.

“Nonetheless, we are slightly updating our leverage guidance 3 , now expecting to end 2026 with a leverage of 2.0x or slightly above, reflecting temporary investments in securing our supply chain and protecting our margins.”
